blocks.rationale: Jointly revise the source-sensitive Representatives exception and its consequence. Current-source reads distinguish the trigger NDA's directors/officers/employees exception from the historical NDA's broader advisor classes, while the terminal rule supports either an inline exception or an express Paragraph 4 cross-reference. This changes nda-7 to Contradiction for the trigger source, preserves nda-5 as Entailment, and preserves both historical disclosure classifications.
